purpose: Evaluate input readiness only, with no classifier, model, feature selection, or diagnostic evidence promotion
rate_source: Original Paderborn measuring logs and official benchmark paper
time_axis_rule: Require strictly increasing, length-matched stored X axis and both max-step and record-duration relative errors <= tolerance. Preserve all originals; no resampling or index-axis substitution.
unit_rule: An empty unit or sensor sensitivity alone does not establish the stored channel's physical unit or calibration scale.
matching_rule: Do not perform physical frequency matching until channel unit/timebase and measured speed/bearing uncertainty provenance satisfy existing tool requirements.
sealed_test_policy: Original archive hash/byte verification only; never list or extract test members in this runner.
eligibility: Input readiness is separate from statistical sample sufficiency and diagnostic profile qualification. Three source labels only, one held-out bearing per class.
